query: Where can one find a summary of the key features of the MediShield Life Scheme?
reference_answer: A summary of the key features of the MediShield Life Scheme can be found in the MediShield Life Scheme booklet.
context:
[Document 1]
A summary of the key features of the MediShield Life Scheme can be found in the MediShield Life Scheme booklet.

[Document 2]
The information in the MediShield Life Scheme booklet is correct as of 1 April 2025.

[Document 3]
The Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board administers the MediShield Life Scheme under the provisions of the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015.

[Document 4]
The CPF Board may impose and vary the terms and conditions of the MediShield Life scheme as provided for in the legislation.

[Document 5]
Older Pioneer Generation seniors with serious pre-existing conditions receive additional MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 annually from 2021 to 2025, which can be used to pay MediShield Life premiums.
answer: One can find a summary of the key features of the MediShield Life Scheme in the MediShield Life Scheme booklet. [Document 1]
